sentences.text: At its October 29, 2026 meeting, the council passed Ordinance 260931, which appropriates $1,000,000.00 for a replacement playground at Barry Road Park.
The council passed Ordinance 260917 amending the Bike Share KC contract for a total of $569,000.00.
It passed Ordinance 260901, which authorizes a three-year $6,510,398.00 contract with VMD Systems Integrators, LLC.
The council passed Ordinance 260935, which approves $1,449,048.68 for a water utility betterment.
Ordinance 260941, which authorizes taxable industrial revenue bonds not to exceed $572,500,000.00, was held on docket for 2 weeks.

Several items were referred to committees, including Ordinance 260956, which would appropriate $2,000,000.00 to the Streetcar Main Street Extension project, and Ordinance 260954, which would accept a $49,000.00 grant award from the Missouri Department of Conservation.
